content.raw:
Medical imaging underpins the diagnosis and treatment planning of many conditions. The imaging unit at our partner hospital brings together radiology and nuclear medicine specialists with a broad range of modern equipment and fully digital reporting. MedLuxLife schedules your examinations, shares preparation instructions in advance and makes sure your images and reports reach you and your doctors at home.

Treatments and services

MRI and functional MRI

3 Tesla MRI, including functional MRI to map vital brain areas before tumour surgery, and MR proton and phosphorus spectroscopy to characterise tumours.

PET/CT

Shows the metabolic activity of tumours and helps determine their location, and can be used to monitor response to treatment.

Nuclear medicine and SPECT

Gamma camera and SPECT imaging, reported by nuclear medicine specialists.

CT, X-ray and fluoroscopy

Multi-slice CT, digital direct radiography, digital fluoroscopy, portable X-ray and C-arm imaging.

Breast and bone imaging

Digital mammography and bone densitometry for breast assessment and bone health.

Ultrasound

4D ultrasonography and Doppler ultrasonography for organ and blood flow assessment.

Molecular imaging

Techniques that add functional and metabolic information to anatomical images, which may help classify tumours and in some cases reduce the need for biopsy.

Interventional radiology

Minimally invasive, image-guided treatments carried out in the dedicated interventional radiology unit, using flat panel digital angiography (DSA).

Digital archiving (PACS and RIS)

All images and reports are stored digitally, shared across the hospital and can be exchanged with imaging centres abroad.

Research

A university setting with ongoing research, including the development of a molecular imaging research unit.

Preparation forms

Before your examination you may be asked to complete a patient information form, an MRI preparation form and a pregnancy information and consent form for radiological examinations.

Imaging equipment

  • 3 Tesla Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI)
  • Multi-slice Computed Tomography (MD-CT)
  • PET/CT
  • Gamma camera - SPECT
  • Flat panel digital angiography (DSA)
  • Digital fluoroscopy
  • Digital direct radiography (X-ray)
  • Digital mammography
  • Bone densitometry
  • 4D ultrasonography
  • Doppler ultrasonography
  • Portable X-ray
  • C-arm

Before you travel

To get a reliable medical opinion quickly, please prepare:

  • Recent medical reports and discharge summaries
  • Imaging (MRI, CT, X-ray) on CD or as DICOM files, with the radiology reports
  • Recent laboratory results
  • A list of your current medications and any allergies
  • Previous imaging on CD or as DICOM files, with reports
  • Details of any implants, pacemaker or metal fragments (important for MRI)

How MedLuxLife supports you

1. Free consultation

Share your wishes and, if available, recent X-rays or photos. We answer your questions and explain the options.

2. Personal treatment plan

Our partner specialists prepare a treatment plan and an estimated timeline tailored to you.

3. Travel & treatment

We coordinate your appointments, hotel and airport transfers, so you can focus on your treatment.

4. Aftercare

We stay in touch after you return home and help with follow-up questions.

Plan your Imaging Unit consultation with confidence

Every treatment begins with a personal, no-obligation consultation. Contact us and we will get back to you as soon as possible.

Request a Free Consultation
WhatsApp

The information on this page is for general guidance only and does not replace a medical consultation. Suitability for any treatment is assessed individually by a qualified doctor.
